Teaching: `os.environ`/`getenv` → `env.get`

What

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0039

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0039: tests/ui/os_environ_teaching.stderr.

Error [E0039]: `os.environ` is written `env.get` in Jet
